# Vision fixtures

The fixture set contains the captured client layout used by the current OSRS
default profile:

- `runelite_client.png` — full client
- `runelite_game_view.png` — game view and tagged trees
- `runelite_control_panel.png` — minimap and control panel
- `runelite_chat.png` — chat panel

The vision tests can use these captures without requiring a live client. These
fixtures intentionally represent the supported default RuneLite setup; adding
other layouts or resolutions is currently out of scope.
